'''2009 Coruscant Regionals Greg Shaw LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2009 Coruscant Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Stealthblind
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
